fields.Status Detail:
Elwood Energy told PJM in May 2024 that it would retire all nine units by June 1, 2025, and in March 2025 asked to extend that to June 1, 2026. PJM letters in 2025 said Hull Street Energy would buy units 1 to 4, 8 and 9. The sale that closed on June 1, 2025 covered units 1 to 4 only, to MPH Elwood LLC, a Hull Street Energy company, which told the Illinois EPA in June 2026 that the four units permanently ceased operation on June 1, 2026. The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists this unit as retired in June 2026.

https://www.pjm.com/-/media/DotCom/planning/gen-retire/deactivation-notices/elwood-deactivation-extension.pdf
https://webapps.illinois.gov/EPA/DocumentExplorer/Documents/Index/170002721348?dwdocid=1518071

verifications.note: A letter of June 15, 2026 from MPH Elwood, LLC to the Illinois EPA, filed in the agency's document library under permit 25070017 and received July 16, 2026. It says MPH Elwood bought four of the nine Elwood turbines, CT-1 through CT-4 at 21100 Noel Road, from Elwood Energy LLC on June 1, 2025, that the Illinois EPA issued MPH Elwood its own operating permit on December 15, 2025, that units CT-5 through CT-9 at 24391 South Patterson Road stayed with Elwood Energy, and that CT-1 through CT-4 permanently ceased operation on June 1, 2026. Signed by a Hull Street Energy officer. Scanned pages read by OCR.

records.researcher_notes: The PJM extension letter from March 2025 asks for a new deactivation date of June 1, 2026 for all nine units. The retirement month comes from the EIA table, which is cited under the status. The June 2026 letter from MPH Elwood LLC to the Illinois EPA gives the purchase date, June 1, 2025, and the date the four units permanently ceased operation, June 1, 2026.
